visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women are in a foreground selfie-style shot. The woman in the center wears a black tank top with text and glasses, flanked by two friends. They all cover their mouths with their hands in a gesture of surprise. Behind them, tall modern skyscrapers and palm trees under a cloudy sky indicate an urban plaza. (2) The camera cuts to a wide shot of a brick-paved square featuring large orange 3D letters spelling 'DANANG BEACH.' Lush palm trees line the background, and the ocean is visible under an overcast sky. A few distant figures walk across the plaza, emphasizing the scale of the beach area. (3) The scene shifts back to the three women in a different location. They maintain their surprised expressions. The center woman wears a black hoodie, and the woman on the left holds a small black handheld device. They are in an outdoor cultural site with stone railings and lush greenery behind them. (4) A tall, majestic white statue of Lady Buddha stands against a cloudy mountain backdrop. The statue is positioned on a decorated lotus base, and several people can be seen at its feet for scale. The lighting is natural but muted by heavy cloud cover, creating a serene atmosphere. (5) The girls appear again, gesturing toward the coastal scenery. They are overlooking a vast blue bay with a modern city skyline visible on the far shore. Green trees frame the foreground, and the water is calm under the hazy sky, suggesting a high-altitude viewpoint. (6) A harbor scene is shown at dusk. Several white catamarans are moored alongside a stone walkway. Ornate street lamps are lit, casting a warm glow. A warning sign with Vietnamese text is visible on the ground near the water's edge, and people walk along the pier. (7) At night, the girls are on a crowded bridge, once again expressing shock with their hands over their mouths. The background features city lights and many people. Blue lights and thick smoke eruptions from a large structure, likely a bridge feature, dominate the background. (8) Close-up of the Dragon Bridge at night during a fire or water breathing performance. Intense blue light illuminates thick clouds of smoke or steam being 'breathed' by the dragon head. Silhouetted spectators stand in the lower frame, capturing the spectacle with their phones.
